title: Retry a VCF Installer depot replacement without duplicate effect
prompt:
Implement the unfinished `VcfInstallerClient.java` as a dependency-free Java 17 client for the VMware Cloud Foundation Installer 9.1 `updateDepotSettings` operation. Keep the implementation in that single Java file, use only the Java standard library, preserve the supplied public API, and do not edit any other file. Before implementing, research `updateDepotSettings` in official VMware sources. Cite the sources consulted in the final answer. Call only `PUT /v1/system/settings/depot`.

`updateDepotSettings(DepotUpdate update, int maxRetries)` replaces the online VMware depot credentials. Require `downloadToken` to be a nonblank string no longer than the documented maximum of 32 characters. Treat a null or blank `downloadActivationCode` as unset. Validate `maxRetries` as an integer from 0 through 5; it counts attempts allowed after the first. Reject invalid credentials or retry counts locally with `IllegalArgumentException` before making a network request. Serialize the representation exactly once and retry only an HTTP 500 response or an ambiguous `IOException` transport failure. Never retry interruption, HTTP 400, or any other HTTP status. Accept exactly HTTP 202 with an `application/json` response object whose `vmwareAccount.downloadToken` and optional `downloadActivationCode` match the submitted effective values. Report exhausted transport failures, rejected HTTP responses, and invalid accepted responses with `IOException`; otherwise fail without putting either credential into an exception message.

Make the commit-before-error case safe: every retry must reuse the same URI, headers, and exact UTF-8 body bytes. This PUT replaces one stable resource, so do not change it to POST, add an attempt identifier, or vary the representation between attempts. The raw target must be exactly `/v1/system/settings/depot`, without a query string or bare `?`. Send exactly one each of `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`, `Accept: application/json`, and `Content-Type: application/json`; use a fixed content length rather than chunked transfer.

The compact request body is `{"vmwareAccount":{"downloadToken":<JSON string>}}` when the activation code is unset. If it is set, add only `downloadActivationCode` inside `vmwareAccount`. Omit all other optional properties rather than sending blank strings, nulls, false, zero, or empty objects: `username`, `password`, `status`, and `message` inside `vmwareAccount`, and top-level `offlineAccount` and `depotConfiguration`. Correctly JSON-escape runtime credential strings.

Run `bash protected_tests/verify.sh`. Verification covers a first valid replacement that commits before HTTP 500 is returned followed by an exact retry that receives HTTP 202. It verifies the complete request wire shape, byte-identical attempts, optional-field omission, retry/error policy, successful response decoding, and one semantic mutation despite two HTTP requests.
scenario: A depot replacement commits before the first HTTP 500 is returned, so an exact retry must complete without producing a second semantic effect.
